finding.name: Unrestricted Upload of File with Dangerous Type
finding.summary: Document.file declares validators=[validate_file_content], a magic-byte content check, but DocumentUploadSerializer.create() persists the upload via Model.objects.create() instead of a ModelForm's is_valid()/full_clean() path, and objects.create() never calls full_clean() - so the field validator is defined but never executes for this endpoint, letting any file content through.
